context: A uni student interviews a retired professor about his publications
purpose: Teach: 著書/書評/購読/補足/創設/学科/学年/知人

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 先生、本日はお時間をいただきありがとうございます。まずは創設に関わられた研究所について伺えますか。
lines.en: Professor, thank you for your time today. First, may I ask about the research institute you helped found?
lines.style: Formal interview opening with deferential keigo throughout.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ああ、あの創設の頃はもう五十年も前になるねえ。当時は文学部の中に新しい学科を作ろうという話でね。
lines.en: Ah, the founding was already fifty years ago now. Back then we were talking about creating a new department within the literature faculty.
lines.style: Nostalgic elderly reminiscing, slow reflective pace with sentence-final ne.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: なるほど。実は先生の最新著書を新聞の書評欄で拝見しまして、ぜひ読んでみたいと思っております。
lines.en: I see. Actually, I saw your latest book in the newspaper's book review section, and I really want to read it.
lines.style: Eager student showing prior research, polite humble form.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ほう、若い人があの書評を読んでくれたとは嬉しいねえ。あれは古い知人が書いてくれたものなんだよ。
lines.en: Oh, it makes me happy that a young person read that review. An old acquaintance of mine wrote it for me.
lines.style: Warm grandfatherly tone, pleasantly surprised with soft chuckle.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: そうだったんですね。差し支えなければ、その著書の内容について少し補足していただけないでしょうか。
lines.en: Is that so. If you don't mind, could you give me a little supplementary explanation about the content of the book?
lines.style: Carefully worded academic request with hedging politeness.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: もちろんいいよ。あの本はね、戦後の教育制度が学年ごとにどう変わってきたか、長年の資料を辿った記録なんだ。
lines.en: Of course, that's fine. That book is a record tracing many years of materials on how the postwar education system changed at each school year level.
lines.style: Generous teaching mode, settling into explanation with casual da.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 学年ごとの変化というのは興味深いですね。実は私も学術誌を定期購読しておりまして、先生の著書もぜひ手元に置きたいです。
lines.en: Changes at each grade level are fascinating. Actually, I also subscribe to an academic journal, and I'd really like to have your book on hand too.
lines.style: Genuine intellectual excitement layered under formal student register.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ぜひぜひ。後で出版社の連絡先を渡そう。少し補足すると、続編も来年出る予定でね、若い研究者と話せて気持ちが弾むよ。
lines.en: By all means. I'll give you the publisher's contact later. To add a little more, a sequel is also planned for next year, and talking with a young researcher lifts my spirits.
lines.style: Warm closing with genuine emotional opening from the elder.
